name: stream-inbox-tags

explain.accuracy: Of the labelled messages, how many the classifier puts under the tag a person confirmed. A message confirmed as 'no tag fits' is right only when the classifier also picks none. The classifier runs as it is now: today's tag tree and today's meanings.

description: The Stream Inbox tag classifier on each labelled message: the tag it picks from the tree as it is now, judged against the confirmed tag.
